name: Fields Pond Foundation Grants
summary: Private foundation grants to community-based nature and land conservation organisations in New England and upper New York State, with proposals accepted at any time.

geography.label: New England and upper New York State

status.quote: Proposals and concept papers may be submitted at any time, since the Directors meet regularly throughout the year.
